title: Seed-to-Staging Onboarding Orchestrator for Community Weights
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement an end-to-end orchestrator that automates community model weight intake from public registries -> deterministic conversion -> multi-stage validation -> staging pin and profile publish. Focus on a reproducible 'seed-to-staging' flow that enables safe canarying of new open-source LLMs while surfacing standardized performance profiles and risk signals.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Orchestrator ingests weights from configured sources (Hugging Face, S3) and verifies checksum/signature. 2) Conversion jobs run deterministically producing runtime-compatible artifacts and a conversion report. 3) Validation suite executes (smoke generation, perf microbench, memory/latency profiling, correctness checks) and writes a normalized profile JSON. 4) Automatic pin recommendation generated (pin candidate + confidence) and published to staging pinflow under read-only tag. 5) Artifacts and profiles are available in artifact gateway with permissions and audit log entries. 6) CI gating: conversion+validation must pass gating rules before staging publish.
progress_updates: 2025-02-12: Ticket created after cross-team design sync (RD, Infra, Runtime). Identified need for reproducible conversion and stronger gating for untrusted community weights.
2025-02-18: Prototype DAG implemented in DAG-runner service. Basic fetch->convert->profile stages wired; uses ephemeral Kubernetes jobs. Early smoke tests pass for GPT-J style weights.
2025-02-24: Added deterministic conversion mode via pinned converter image and fixed seed for tokenizer normalization. Observed non-determinism in weight sharding step; created subtask ENG-51145.

2025-03-01: Validation harness extended with latency microbench (p50/p95), GPU memory trace, and basic sample-quality checks (perplexity and hallucination heuristics). Integration tests added to CI but currently run in separate gated pipeline due to runtime GPU quotas.

2025-03-05: Completed first end-to-end run for 'orca-mini' import: conversion artifacts in s3://redwood-artifacts/onboard/ENG-51102/orca-mini/20250305/, profile.json present, pin recommendation generated (confidence low -> requires manual review).
decisions: Use content-addressed S3 paths for artifact storage and attach a signed manifest to every onboarding run to enable auditability.
Conversion must run in a hermetic container image (runtime-converter:v2025-02) to enforce deterministic outputs across environments.
Profile schema v2 selected (fields: seq_dist, p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, gpu_mem_mb, flops_estimate, basic_eval_scores, compatibility_tags, risk_signals).
Staging pinflow will be read-only automatic except when 'confidence' < 0.7, in which case the flow requires PM sign-off in Console.
tradeoffs: Deterministic conversion increases developer friction (must rebuild converter image for changes) but limits non-reproducible failures during downstream benchmarking.
Running full eval suites during onboarding would provide better signal but would delay onboarding time and increase cost — we keep a lightweight core suite and schedule extended runs asynchronously.
Blocking automatic publish for low-confidence models reduces risk but slows time-to-availability for popular community models; mitigated by faster manual review workflow in Console.
review_feedback: From Runtime team (Jasdeep): ensure converter emits deterministic dtype/quantization headers to avoid runtime mismatch. Added unit tests for header parity.
From Security (Marta): require signature verification for any non-official hub sources and log KMS key ID used for manifest signing. Security review flagged credential rotation for onboarding agent.
From PM (Diego): add a 'rollback pin' fast path so that a bad staging pin can be reverted quickly without reprocessing artifacts.
blockers: ENG-51145: nondeterministic weight sharding in converter - root cause under investigation (vendor lib vs custom code).
GPU quota for gated CI prevents running extended validation in the same pipeline; need dedicated infra pool (infra ticket ENG-51300).
next_steps: Triage ENG-51145 (converter sharding) with vendor lib maintainers - target patch by 2025-03-12.
Provision a small dedicated GPU pool for gated onboarding CI (coordinate with Infra team, ENG-51300).
Add automated manifest signing and KMS integration to DAG-runner (security follow-up).
Wire Console review modal to accept/reject low-confidence pin recommendations and record review notes in the manifest.
